root_cause.text: The function sma1307_setting_loaded() incorrectly used kfree() to free memory that was allocated with devm_kzalloc(), leading to a double-free when the kernel’s device resource management (devres) later automatically releases the same memory.
root_cause.evidence: Both the CVE description and commit message explicitly state that the mode_set entries are allocated with devm_kzalloc() and must not be freed with kfree(); doing so causes a double free. The patch replaces the manual kfree() loop with devm_kfree() and NULL assignments to ensure proper managed cleanup.
